Ball Club Data is an independent project that I develop and maintain in my spare time. Every dataset is carefully collected, cleaned, and maintained, and new features are continually being added to make college baseball statistics more accessible and insightful.

The site will always remain free to use. If you've found it valuable and would like to support its continued development, your contribution is greatly appreciated.

Your support helps fund website hosting and allows me to continue expanding the platform with additional conferences, historical data, and new analytical tools.

### Ways Your Support Helps

- Expanding the College Baseball Explorer
- Maintaining and updating historical datasets
- Building new visualizations and analytical tools
- Covering website hosting and operating costs
